prefixes.complete_norm_class_proof: For primitive r, q(r) divides 2I(r), I(r)=(a*x,G_R*y). Outside (2), primes dividing a, and the E6 discriminant prime (3), local unimodularity makes I(r)=O.  At (3), the E6 radical modulo 3 is generated by (1,2,0,1,2,0), whose square is 12 mod 18, so a primitive radical vector has v_3(q)=1.  At every squarefree prime dividing a, either I(r)=O or y is locally divisible and x is a unit, which gives v(q)=1.  The inert prime (2) likewise has exponent at most one.  Class number one and the full unit-signature rank imply that every totally positive unit is a square. Hence (q) is one of (1),(2),(3),(6).
prefixes.scope: Every primitive mirror-norm class and every Vinberg level through the stated exact height is exhaustive. Failure of finite volume is only a prefix result unless the geometry is finite-volume.
